commands: git branch -a && git status --short && git log --oneline -5

starbridge ask \
  --question "Which settings-screen variant should I merge to main?" \
  --context "Both variants pass the tests. Images attached in option order.
Compact: all 9 rows fit on one screen, no scrolling, tighter rows.
Roomy: taller rows with bigger touch targets, but only 6 of 9 fit — needs scrolling." \
  --option "Compact" --option "Roomy" \
  --image shots/compact.png --image shots/roomy.png
turns.final: The compact variant fits all 9 rows without scrolling; the roomy variant has taller, easier-to-tap rows but needs scrolling. This pick is the owner's, so I'll post a Starbridge card with both screenshots.
